# Phase 2G security review

This is a focused code/control review with bounded credential scans and negative tests, not an independent penetration test or production security approval. Existing lifecycle implementations were preserved. No real secret was included in test fixtures or release artifacts.

| Surface | Reviewed control and evidence | Remaining boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Registration token | Key Vault references only; Managed Identity obtains secrets; private register.json writer uses product ownership and 0600; transient input removed after success; provider clears held secret wrappers in finally | Python strings cannot guarantee memory erasure; revocation/rotation and failure-residual inspection are operator duties |
| Key Vault | Fixed HTTPS vault suffix and secret-name grammar, bounded calls, no redirect bearer forwarding, fixed errors; unit failures cover auth/access/missing/empty/timeout | Identity/RBAC/egress must be provisioned per VM; no fleet authorization claim |
| credentials.txt | Existence and identity state observed without returning contents; complete uninstall removes the product tree | Product maintains 0640 file; root/product-account access remains privileged |
| TranDb password | DbInfo section parsing; bundled psql argv, PGPASSWORD in subprocess environment; no shell interpolation, no password in output | Privileged process/environment inspection is in the trust boundary; debug_info contains metadata only |
| Truststore password | keytool uses environment password interface; QA default confined to exact tested tuple, not argv/results | Controlled default is QA only; production secret reference and rotation require review |
| Artifact URLs | Opaque vendor paths are source metadata, not classified as credentials; URLs omitted from ordinary version/list identities | Inspection manifests deliberately retain provenance URLs; prevent unnecessary log repetition |
| Latest endpoint | Only explicit requests; HTTPS redirects checked to allowlisted hosts; authentication failures fixed; HTML/non-ar rejected; exact dpkg-deb Package/Version/Architecture/Depends plus SHA-256 | Additional CDN/auth flows fail closed; metadata verification does not establish vendor provenance |
| Package execution | Inspection never executes/extracts package scripts; native install rechecks full version, arch and digest before dpkg | Debian maintainer scripts execute as root during authorized installation; independent production artifact approval remains required |
| Command injection | CLI/parser input validation; subprocess argv lists; no shell=True in lifecycle/provider paths; Support Tools stdin allowlist; installer environment constant | Version-specific adapter changes need review; Azure config/guest permissions must prevent tampering |
| Temporary files/cache | Private temporary directories; exclusive no-follow writes; 2-GiB package and 600-second download bounds; serial batch cleanup; cache version+hash, cached bytes rehashed | Cache retention/disk quotas are operator policy; installer existing staging conventions remain preserved |
| Result JSON/debug | Fixed errors; whitelist Support Tools metadata; no raw command output or exception strings; new immutable 0600 result files | Result paths must be private; local-only diagnostics and null probes must not be treated as composite health |
| Release | Allowlisted source staging; excludes QA evidence, packages, PEM/key/pyc/log files; bounded scan; digest and per-file hashes; tar traversal/link/duplicate/size checks | Sidecar and file hashes are integrity checks, not release signing; use independently approved deployment hash |
| Python supply chain | Exact requirement versions; separate venv | No bundled wheels or dependency hashes; approved index and supply-chain review remain required |

Negative tests cover malformed package identity, full version mismatch, pinned digest drift, unsafe URL/redirect, HTML response, bounded download, immutable metadata, corrupted hash cache, unqualified/latest guards, blocked release override, explicit live-regression flag, dirty host, bundle symlink and archive corruption. Existing tests cover secret clearing/redaction, Key Vault failures, registration input permissions, rollback and TranDb error handling.

The controlled QA default truststore password and opaque download URL components are not accidentally reported as production credential leaks. The bounded scanner detects private-key blocks, URL credential query parameters and suspicious literal assignments; synthetic test strings are excluded from that source scan. This cannot prove absence of all secrets. Release signing, artifact independent verification, production sizing and organizational security sign-off remain pending.

The RC production install path additionally requires approved governance status, PRODUCTION_APPROVED artifact status and INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED integrity classification. Controlled-test projections are memory-local and never write back to the catalogue. Denied artifacts and BLOCKED/DEPRECATED runtime entries cannot be overridden. Optional latest observations reject symlinks, public modes and oversized files before reading them.
